ATM Network and Locations: Locally and overseas, your Horizon card is accepted at Horizon-branded ATMs and Standard Chartered Bank ATMs that accept Visa. Horizon-branded machines are located at FairPrice Xtra Vivocity, unit B2-23, while Standard Chartered Bank ATMs are available at locations including Bedok Mall, Bugis Junction, Vivocity, Sixth Avenue, Clementi Mall, NEX Serangoon, Serangoon Garden, Marine Parade, Changi Business Park, Tampines, Marina Bay Financial Centre, and Battery Road. Please note that the operating bank may charge its own surcharge, which Horizon does not control.
Account Selection and Fees: If you hold both a credit card account and a savings account linked to your card, select "Savings Account" at the ATM so the withdrawal is drawn from your savings. If the machine does not offer this option, the transaction will be processed as a cash advance, which incurs a cash advance fee effective 1 Feb 2026 and accrues interest from the withdrawal date.
